messages:
Nina: Quick heads-up — I want to start a staged unpin of runtime 2.15 for the EU canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC, 2h timebox. We've got latency regressions on quant-v4b that runtime 3.2 fixed in bench runs.
Mike: +1 to the timebox but can we gate on telemetry thresholds before we proceed? last time we saw a silent degradation.
Olivia: What are the rollout steps? can we do a small cohort first (10% canary) then 50% then full?
Nina: Plan: 10% -> 50% -> 100% inside the 2h window, each step automatic if metrics look good. Rollback immediate on threshold breach.
Sam: thresholds proposed: error rate increase >0.5% absolute OR p95 latency up >30% vs baseline -> rollback. Also watch memory OOM signs.
Juan: For SDK consumers, heads-up: this unpin will allow runtime features that require sdk>=2.8.0. We should post a quick release note and a Slack ping to #general.
Nina: Good call. I drafted a short blurb for docs/whats-new: "Unpinning runtime 2.15 in EU canary — enables improved quant v4b kernel paths; consumers using older SDKs may need to bump to 2.8.0+" Would someone paste it to the release-notes doc?
Olivia: I can do that. Also adding a short checklist for QA: smoke gen tests, long-sequence stability, embedding fidelity for top-1.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled rollout created by @Nina — unpin-runtime-2.15 -> runtime-3.2 (EU canary) at 2026-03-23T02:00:00Z. Cohorts: 10%,50%,100%. Runbook: https://intra/release/runbooks/unpin-2.15
Sam: Ops question: does the routing layer need a cache invalidation step? prefix cache might still have KVs compiled for old runtime binaries.
Juan: Good point — plan includes an in-place cache drain per node. ops-bot will trigger a controlled drain before traffic switch.
ops-bot: ops-bot: scheduled cache-drain job queued on canary pool at +10m into the window. Estimated drain time 90s per instance.
Mike: What about model compatibility? any model variants that were pinned to 2.15? we should check pinlist to avoid accidental mismatch.
Nina: I ran a quick query: one customer-specific Llama3q variant had an explicit binding; ops flagged it and we'll exclude it from cohort. I'll attach the diff:
Nina: ```diff
- runtime:2.15 -> models: llama3q-custA
+ runtime:3.2 (excluded for llama3q-custA)
```
Olivia: Perfect. Add a note to deploybot to skip those model IDs.
deploybot: deploybot: pinlist update applied — skipped models: llama3q-custA (id: m-73a9). Cohort rule: exclude m-73a9 from canary.
Sam: I'll watch the dashboards. If p95 jumps or token throughput dips >20% we hit rollback.
Mike: Also add a short grab-bag test: curl the /generate endpoint with long-seq flag and confirm p99 token generation < 500ms on canary nodes.
Nina: Good test — Olivia can run it during the 10% step. Olivia: noted.
Olivia: Quick FYI to docs: release note posted and will ping #general 10m prior to window.
Juan: Post-rollout checklist: verify SDK telemetry count for incompatible calls drops to 0; run integration smoke across top-5 customers.
Nina: After the window, if all green we'll push the same unpin to other regions next week. If any unexpected regressions, we'll pin back to 2.15 and open an incident.
Mike: 👍 one more ask: can we capture a canary dump (perf profiles + KV stats) at each step and attach to the ticket? will make triage faster.
Nina: Yes — automated snapshots are enabled in the runbook.
Olivia: I'm good for the nightshift handoff. Will be awake for the 02:00 window.
Sam: I'll be on pager. Juan will cover SDK comms.
deploybot: deploybot: update — pre-checks passed (health probes, image signatures). Ready for scheduled rollout.
Nina: Thanks team. If no objections by EOD I'll hit the green button and notify CS + docs.
Mike: No objections from me.
Juan: 👍
Olivia: go for it :rocket:
